english.title: Keeper of a motor vehicle fail to give information re keeper
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the keeper of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was alleged to have been used on a road in contravention of section 29 of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994, failed to give such information as to the identity of the person who kept the said vehicle on the road as you were required to give by or on behalf of the

(A)_[Chief Officer of Police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE..)]_
(B)_[Secretary of State]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(4) and (5) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
